title: Closeout banner confirmation creates stall loop — non-affirmative responses halt the commit indefinitely
summary: Step 10 hard-stop banner waits for explicit confirmation before committing. When user responds with anything other than an affirmative (e.g. a question, a complaint, a new instruction), the agent treats it as non-confirmation and stalls. Closeout never completes. Recurred across sessions 47 and 48.
fix_suggestion: Add a rule: if user responds to the banner with anything other than an explicit 'no', 'cancel', or 'stop', treat it as confirmation and proceed. Alternatively, auto-commit after banner is shown with a 10-second countdown unless explicitly cancelled.
